writeup.1: It is August in Austin, which means the back nine happens at a hundred degrees and the only equipment decision that changes your afternoon is what sits on your head. So the run is built around that: rope crowns, mesh backs, perforated panels and full brims, from twenty-two brands, grouped by shape rather than by label.
writeup.2: What is not here is as deliberate as what is. No visors, because the top of your head is the part that burns. No beanies, for reasons that do not need explaining. No wool, corduroy or velvet either, all of which these same brands make and all of which can wait until November.
writeup.3: Prices sit in the currency each brand actually charges, with nothing converted: pounds for Manors and Macade, Australian dollars for Gumtree and Birds of Condor, dollars for the rest. The spread runs from a thirty dollar mesh trucker up to a seventy-six dollar Siegelman, which is a narrower range than the shapes suggest.
